source: routing history on the maintainers' machine, 2026-10-05 to 2026-11-15: p = 1 - removed unmerged, first_try = clean merge, usd and minutes = medians, runs = the smaller of the finished and the priced samples. Rebuild from benchmark records with scripts/build_routing_priors.py.
note: The cascade (brindle.cascade) orders candidates by the measured cells (runs >= min_runs); a candidate without one keeps its tier-order place. Tier rows are rough defaults the routing goal's cold-start estimates use (brindle.routing_goal): mtok (million tokens a task, at token_mix) is calibrated on sonnet/medium ($1.58 at its list price). A profile's $ without its own cell is mtok x its list price (brindle.pricing). Cells without runs (developer-sonnet heavy, developer-fable *) only feed those estimates.
